The analysis was methodical - extracting project files from the binlog, finding the AppConfigFile parameter, identifying the version mismatch between 10.0.0.0 and 10.0.0.3. The agent took many steps (57 tool calls) which is somewhat inefficient, but ultimately arrived at the correct conclusion with a proper fix suggestion. One minor gap is that the agent couldn't actually read the full App.config file contents as specifically requested in the prompt, but inferred the content from string analysis of the binlog.
